text.p: Easco Inc said on Wednesday it had named Norman Wells Jr. president and chief executive, and Terry Smith chief financial officer of the company.
A spokesman for Easco said that Wells was replacing the previous president and chief executive Michael Hagerty, who has resigned, and Smith was replacing Bruce Kirchner, who has also resigned.
No reasons were given for the resignations.
Wells was previously president and chief executive of CasTech Aluminum Group Inc, which was acquired by Commonwealth Aluminum Corp in September, Easco said in a statement.
Smith was also with CasTech, serving as chief financial officer, secretary and treasurer.
The company additionally announced it had named Joseph Byers as vice president of sales and marketing. Byers was previously vice president of sales and marketing at Barmet, a subsidiary of CasTech.
